trim.definition: To cut a small amount from the ends of hair.

layers.definition: Sections of hair cut to different lengths to create shape or volume.

bob.definition: A haircut in which the hair ends around the jaw or neck.

fade.definition: A haircut in which hair gradually becomes shorter toward the sides and back.

undercut.definition: A haircut with very short sides beneath longer hair on top.

twist.definition: To turn strands of hair around one another to shape a hairstyle.

pin.definition: A small fastener used to hold hair in place.

diffuser.definition: A hair-dryer attachment that spreads airflow over a wider area.

aftershave.definition: A lotion or other product applied to the skin after shaving.

hair-gel.definition: A thick styling product used to hold hair in place.

highlights.definition: Sections of hair colored lighter than the surrounding hair.

bleach.definition: A product used by hair professionals to lighten hair color.

toner.definition: A hair-color product used to adjust or neutralize unwanted tones.

color-wheel.definition: A circular chart showing colors and their relationships.

taper.definition: A haircut in which hair gradually shortens near the neckline and sides.

scissors.definition: A tool with two hinged blades used to cut hair.

brush.definition: A tool with bristles used to arrange or untangle hair.

cape.definition: A protective covering worn around a client during salon services.

serum.definition: A concentrated hair-care product used to improve the hair's feel or appearance.

oil.definition: An oil-based product applied to condition or style hair.

mask.definition: A conditioning product left on hair for a time before being rinsed out.

station.definition: A salon work area with a chair, mirror, and styling tools.

sink.definition: A basin equipped for washing and rinsing a client's hair.

reception.definition: The area where salon clients are welcomed and appointments are managed.

taper.definition: A haircut in which hair gradually shortens near the neckline and sides.

mullet.definition: A haircut with shorter hair at the front and sides and longer hair at the back.

bob.definition: A haircut in which the hair ends around the jaw or neck.

layers.definition: Sections of hair cut to different lengths to create shape or volume.

clippers.definition: An electric tool with moving blades used to cut hair short.

scissors.definition: A tool with two hinged blades used to cut hair.

trimmer.definition: A small electric grooming tool used to shape hair or beard edges.

cape.definition: A protective covering worn around a client during barber services.

hot-towel.definition: A warmed towel used for comfort or preparation during grooming services.

conditioning.definition: Applying a hair-care product to make hair softer or easier to manage.

coloring.definition: Changing or adding color to hair using a coloring product.

highlights.definition: Sections of hair colored lighter than the surrounding hair.

aftershave.definition: A lotion or other product applied to the skin after shaving.

tonic.definition: A liquid grooming product applied to hair or the scalp.

oil.definition: An oil-based product applied to condition hair or a beard.

cream.definition: A soft grooming product used for skin care, shaving, or styling.

powder.definition: A fine dry grooming product applied to skin or hair.

headrest.definition: A support for the client's head attached to a barber chair.

counter.definition: A work or service surface for tools, products, or payments.

sterilizer.definition: Equipment used to sterilize compatible tools under a specified process.

pole.definition: A striped sign traditionally used to identify a barbershop.

barber.definition: A person whose job is to cut hair and groom beards.

client.definition: A person receiving a barber's services.

apprentice.definition: A trainee learning barbering through supervised work.

appointment.definition: An agreed date and time for a service.

tip.definition: Extra money a client gives to staff for their service.

massage.definition: Pressing and rubbing muscles and soft tissues using hands or equipment.

facial.definition: A cosmetic treatment that cleanses and cares for facial skin.

scrub.definition: A textured skin-care product or treatment used for exfoliation.

aromatherapy.definition: A practice using scented plant oils, often during relaxation or massage.

reflexology.definition: A complementary practice that applies pressure to parts of the feet, hands, or ears.

hydrotherapy.definition: The use of water as part of a supervised therapeutic activity or treatment.

pool.definition: A constructed basin filled with water for swimming or bathing.

reception.definition: The area where spa visitors are welcomed and bookings are managed.

terrace.definition: An outdoor paved area beside or above a building.

cream.definition: A soft cosmetic product applied to the skin.

mask.definition: A skin-care preparation left on the skin for a time before removal.

serum.definition: A lightweight skin-care product containing concentrated ingredients.

mud.definition: A wet earthy material used in some spa treatments.

incense.definition: A scented material that releases fragrance when burned.

diffuser.definition: A device that disperses fragrance or scented oils into the air.

toner.definition: A liquid skin-care product usually applied after cleansing.

cleanser.definition: A skin-care product used to remove dirt, oil, or makeup.

basin.definition: A bowl-shaped container or fixture used to hold water.

headrest.definition: A support for a person's head on a treatment chair or table.

meditation.definition: A practice of focusing attention or observing thoughts to develop awareness.

mindfulness.definition: Attention to present experience, including thoughts, feelings, and sensations.

detox.definition: In spa marketing, a label for treatments claimed to cleanse the body; it does not establish toxin removal.

hydration.definition: Having or maintaining enough water in the body.

sleep.definition: A natural resting state in which awareness and activity are reduced.

relaxation.definition: A state of reduced tension and a feeling of ease.

acupuncture.definition: A practice in which trained practitioners insert thin needles at selected points on the body.

shiatsu.definition: A Japanese form of bodywork that uses finger or hand pressure.

attendant.definition: A worker who assists guests and maintains spa facilities.

concierge.definition: A worker who assists visitors with arrangements, bookings, or information.
